sentence: This project tests whether boosting the cleanup centers inside brain cells called lysosomes helps brain tissue heal around implanted electrodes.
This project builds a network of researchers and industry partners to explore how people work with sensors, computers and software in manufacturing.
This project studies how chemicals and microbes on indoor surfaces and in the air affect each other and the quality of the air.
This project builds a way for legged robots to learn from both computer simulations and real experiments to walk better.
This project builds a platform that designs antibodies and other drug candidates aimed at the clumped proteins found in amyloid diseases.
This project studies how bacteria in a wastewater system that removes nitrogen respond to changing conditions, using computer models to predict how well it works.
This project builds a drone with thermal imaging that finds energy loss in homes and pairs it with a 3D model to plan retrofitting.
This project builds computer methods that read DNA from single cancer cells to trace how tumors change over time.
This project builds tiny pixels that trap light and heat so an optical image filter works with the weak light of everyday sources.
This project studies how people learn to walk more efficiently with wearable robotic exoskeletons and how the robot can coach them.
This project studies how humans and mice decide when to leave one area and search a new one for resources.
This project studies data from a xenon detector to search for a rare decay that would show neutrinos and anti-neutrinos are the same particle.
This project develops hands-on labs that teach how to defend the computer systems used in advanced manufacturing against attacks.
This project builds lab models of the tissue around a tumor to study how cancer cells interact with nearby cells and escape into blood vessels.
This project builds machine learning methods that use physics to predict how cells move and change shape in changing surroundings.
This project builds small chips that mimic organs to study how human immune cells move and behave, and pairs them with mathematical models.
This project does research on optics, with a focus on ultrafast lasers, across fields such as plasma physics and biomedical imaging.
